ability.infinity.reality_stone.reality_p: Reality says it is yours. Left (aiming) at a mob: it becomes your pet (red crown, never despawns, never attacks you or allies); at your own pet: select it (orders go to it alone). Right: order menu — Sit, Follow (teleports to you when far), Attack target (your next left click on a creature picks the target; even cows deal damage), Guard here, Release. Max 8 pets; no bosses; another player's pet can't be stolen. Your pets defend you automatically.
ability.infinity.reality_stone.broken_mo: On/off. Reality glitches around you: blocks flicker into other blocks for everyone nearby, your screen gets a red aberration, your hits glitch the target (short teleport + 30% damage) and ALL your Reality abilities are ×1.5. Price: you take +25% damage and hunger drains fast.
ability.infinity.reality_stone.local_dec: Laws of reality. Left (aiming): decree the chosen law in a rune circle at the aimed point for 45 s. Right: law menu — Peace, Lightness, Weight, Silence, Inversion. Alt+scroll: radius 6–16. Applies to everyone inside, you included. One decree per player.
ability.infinity.reality_stone.mirage.de: Lie to other people's eyes. Left (aiming at a block): the N×N square on the aimed face looks like the block in your off hand to other players (empty hand = invisible); the real block does not change. You see a red outline. 2 min, up to 64 blocks. Right: undo all. Alt+scroll: size 1–5.
ability.infinity.reality_stone.metamorph: Rewrite the species. Left (aiming at a mob): it bursts into red fragments and becomes the chosen species, keeping its name and % of health. Right: species menu. Alt+scroll: change species. Mobs only (no players or bosses).
